notes.subject: dikgaba
notes.rationale: חבלים ka tlwaelo ke 'dithapo' — fela mo ke bohloko bja go belega, go swana le צירים; Sepedi 'kgaba' e swara kgaba ya mmele

notes.subject: go hlolela
notes.rationale: יחילון ke 'go dikanyega, go potoloha' — lentšu le tee le dihlogwana tša go belega le go gogoga; Sepedi 'go hlolela' ke bokae fela

notes.subject: malelapa a mollo
notes.rationale: להבים ke 'maflasho' — a ka ba ditlhasedi goba dinthla tša dibaya; 'lelapa la mollo' e tšea sebopego sa go fapana

translation: Mme ba tla tšhologa mahlatse; mahlatse a go belega le dikgaba di tla ba swara, ba hlolela bjalo ka mosadi wa go belega; motho o tla makala ka mogwera wa gagwe; difahlego tša bona di tla ba bjalo ka malelapa a mollo.

tokens.gloss: bjalo ka mosadi wa go belega
